research.searchCoverage: Official Intercom API and security materials reviewed on 2026-09-13.

Official Intercom API and security materials reviewed on 2026-09-13 for global edition, token authentication, v2 list endpoints and start/limit pagination. No qualifying current customer-data breach found in bounded review; this is dated coverage and not a breach-free claim.
research.qualityRationale: Useful bounded CRM list reads with documented Authorization authentication.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the Intercom token by listing one administrator.

admins.list.title: List Admins
admins.list.description: List accessible Intercom administrators, optionally including avatar data.

contacts.list.title: List Contacts
contacts.list.description: List accessible Intercom contacts with bounded pagination.

companies.list.title: List Companies
companies.list.description: List accessible Intercom companys with bounded pagination.

conversations.list.title: List Conversations
conversations.list.description: List Intercom conversations with bounded cursor pagination (per_page, starting_after).

conversations.get.title: Get Conversation
conversations.get.description: Retrieve a single Intercom conversation by id (includes conversation_parts).

conversations.reply.title: Reply to Conversation
conversations.reply.description: Reply to an Intercom conversation as an admin (comment or note) via POST /conversations/{id}/reply. EffectPolicy Idempotent projects conversation id from the primary response and observes via conversations.get (handler returns raw Conversation).

id.description: Intercom conversation id, or the literal "last".

messageType.description: comment posts to the customer; note is internal.

conversations.close.title: Close Conversation
conversations.close.description: Close an Intercom conversation via POST /conversations/{id}/parts (message_type close). EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via conversations.get.

conversations.assign.title: Assign Conversation
conversations.assign.description: Assign an Intercom conversation via POST /conversations/{id}/parts (message_type assignment). assigneeId may be admin or team id; "0" unassigns. EffectPolicy Reconcile observes via conversations.get.

conversations.tag.title: Tag Conversation
conversations.tag.description: Add a tag via POST /conversations/{id}/tags (body id=tagId, admin_id). Upstream returns Tag; EffectPolicy Reconcile observes conversation via conversations.get.

contacts.get.title: Get Contact
contacts.get.description: Retrieve a single Intercom contact by id via GET /contacts/{id}.

conversations.search.title: Search Conversations
conversations.search.description: Search Intercom conversations via POST /conversations/search. Pass Intercom Search query object; optional perPage/startingAfter map to pagination.

query.description: Intercom Search query (single filter {field,operator,value} or AND/OR tree).

contacts.create.title: Create Contact
contacts.create.description: Create an Intercom contact via POST /contacts. email is required. Optional role (user or lead), name, externalId, phone.

role.description: Contact role. Defaults to user on the provider side if omitted.

contacts.update.title: Update Contact
contacts.update.description: Update an Intercom contact via PUT /contacts/{id}. id is required. Only the fields you pass are changed.

contacts.delete.title: Delete Contact
contacts.delete.description: Permanently delete an Intercom contact via DELETE /contacts/{id}. This cannot be undone.

companies.create.title: Create Company
companies.create.description: Create an Intercom company via POST /companies. companyId is the caller-defined company id (maps to company_id) and is required. Optional name, website, industry, plan.

companies.get.title: Get Company
companies.get.description: Retrieve a single Intercom company by id via GET /companies/{id}.

tickets.list.title: List Tickets
tickets.list.description: Search Intercom tickets via POST /tickets/search (Intercom has no unfiltered GET /tickets list). Pass an Intercom Search query object; optional perPage/startingAfter map to pagination.

query.description: Intercom Search query (single filter {field,operator,value} or AND/OR tree).

tickets.create.title: Create Ticket
tickets.create.description: Create an Intercom ticket via POST /tickets. ticketTypeId and contacts are required. Optional ticketAttributes is the Intercom ticket_attributes object (e.g. _default_title_, _default_description_).

contacts.description: Contacts to attach, each typically {id} or {email}.

tickets.reply.title: Reply to Ticket
tickets.reply.description: Reply to an Intercom ticket via POST /tickets/{id}/reply as an admin (comment or note).

messageType.description: comment posts to the customer; note is internal.

tags.create.title: Create Tag
tags.create.description: Create an Intercom tag via POST /tags. name is required. If a tag with that name exists, Intercom returns the existing tag.

contacts.tag.title: Tag Contact
contacts.tag.description: Attach a tag to an Intercom contact via POST /contacts/{id}/tags. Body id is the tag id.

admins.get.title: Get Admin
admins.get.description: Retrieve a single Intercom administrator by id via GET /admins/{id}.

contacts.archive.title: Archive Contact
contacts.archive.description: Archive an Intercom contact via POST /contacts/{id}/archive.

contacts.unarchive.title: Unarchive Contact
contacts.unarchive.description: Unarchive an Intercom contact via POST /contacts/{id}/unarchive.

contacts.block.title: Block Contact
contacts.block.description: Block an Intercom contact via POST /contacts/{id}/block. Conversations for the contact are archived.

contacts.search.title: Search Contacts
contacts.search.description: Search Intercom contacts via POST /contacts/search. Pass an Intercom Search query object; optional perPage/startingAfter map to pagination.

query.description: Intercom Search query (single filter {field,operator,value} or AND/OR tree).

contacts.merge.title: Merge Lead into User
contacts.merge.description: Merge a lead contact into a user via POST /contacts/merge. The `from` lead is permanently removed.

from.description: Lead contact id to merge away.

into.description: User contact id to merge into.

contacts.untag.title: Remove Tag from Contact
contacts.untag.description: Detach a tag from a contact via DELETE /contacts/{id}/tags/{tagId}.

contacts.listTags.title: List Contact Tags
contacts.listTags.description: List tags attached to a contact via GET /contacts/{id}/tags.

contacts.listCompanies.title: List Contact Companies
contacts.listCompanies.description: List companies attached to a contact via GET /contacts/{id}/companies.

contacts.listSegments.title: List Contact Segments
contacts.listSegments.description: List segments attached to a contact via GET /contacts/{id}/segments.

contacts.listSubscriptions.title: List Contact Subscriptions
contacts.listSubscriptions.description: List subscription types attached to a contact via GET /contacts/{id}/subscriptions.

contacts.addSubscription.title: Add Subscription to Contact
contacts.addSubscription.description: Attach a subscription type to a contact via POST /contacts/{id}/subscriptions. Body id is the subscription type id; consentType is opt_in or opt_out.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription type id (maps to body id).

contacts.removeSubscription.title: Remove Subscription from Contact
contacts.removeSubscription.description: Detach a subscription type from a contact via DELETE /contacts/{id}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}.

contacts.attachCompany.title: Attach Contact to Company
contacts.attachCompany.description: Attach a company to a contact via POST /contacts/{id}/companies. Body id is the company id.

contacts.detachCompany.title: Detach Contact from Company
contacts.detachCompany.description: Detach a company from a contact via DELETE /contacts/{id}/companies/{companyId}.

contacts.notes.create.title: Create Contact Note
contacts.notes.create.description: Create a note on a contact via POST /contacts/{id}/notes.

adminId.description: Admin id authoring the note (maps to admin_id).

contacts.notes.list.title: List Contact Notes
contacts.notes.list.description: List notes for a contact via GET /contacts/{id}/notes.

contacts.getByExternalId.title: Get Contact by External ID
contacts.getByExternalId.description: Retrieve a user contact via GET /contacts/find_by_external_id/{externalId}. Leads are not supported on this route.

externalId.description: External id provided by your system.

companies.update.title: Update Company
companies.update.description: Update a company via PUT /companies/{id}. company_id cannot be changed after create.

companies.delete.title: Delete Company
companies.delete.description: Delete a company via DELETE /companies/{id}. Contacts are detached; the company record is retained in the workspace.

companies.listContacts.title: List Company Contacts
companies.listContacts.description: List contacts attached to a company via GET /companies/{id}/contacts.

companies.listSegments.title: List Company Segments
companies.listSegments.description: List segments attached to a company via GET /companies/{id}/segments.

companies.listNotes.title: List Company Notes
companies.listNotes.description: List notes for a company via GET /companies/{id}/notes.

companies.scroll.title: Scroll Companies
companies.scroll.description: Iterate all companies via GET /companies/scroll. Only one scroll can be open per app; pass scrollParam to continue.

scrollParam.description: Scroll cursor from a previous response (maps to scroll_param).

companies.retrieve.title: Retrieve Companies
companies.retrieve.description: Fetch a company by company_id or name, or filter by tag_id/segment_id, via GET /companies.

tagId.description: Filter by tag id (maps to tag_id).

segmentId.description: Filter by segment id (maps to segment_id).

conversations.create.title: Create Conversation
conversations.create.description: Create a contact-initiated conversation via POST /conversations. fromType/fromId identify the contact; body is the message.

conversations.reopen.title: Reopen Conversation
conversations.reopen.description: Reopen a snoozed or closed conversation via POST /conversations/{id}/parts with message_type open.

adminId.description: Admin performing the reopen (maps to admin_id).

conversations.untag.title: Detach Tag from Conversation
conversations.untag.description: Remove a tag from a conversation via DELETE /conversations/{id}/tags/{tagId}. adminId is sent in the body.

adminId.description: Admin removing the tag (maps to admin_id).

conversations.attachContact.title: Attach Contact to Conversation
conversations.attachContact.description: Add a contact participant via POST /conversations/{id}/customers.

adminId.description: Admin adding the participant (maps to admin_id).

customer.description: Contact identifier object with at least one of id, user_id, or email.

isShared.description: Whether the ticket is shared (maps to is_shared).

snoozedUntil.description: Unix timestamp to snooze until (maps to snoozed_until).

tickets.delete.title: Delete Ticket
tickets.delete.description: Permanently delete a ticket via DELETE /tickets/{id}.

tickets.enqueue.title: Enqueue Create Ticket

tickets.tag.description: Add a tag to a ticket via POST /tickets/{id}/tags.

adminId.description: Admin applying the tag (maps to admin_id).

tickets.untag.title: Detach Tag from Ticket
tickets.untag.description: Remove a tag from a ticket via DELETE /tickets/{id}/tags/{tagId}. adminId is sent in the body.

adminId.description: Admin removing the tag (maps to admin_id).

sections.create.description: Create a help center section via POST /help_center/sections. parentId is the parent collection.

internalArticles.create.title: Create Internal Article
internalArticles.create.description: Create an internal article via POST /internal_articles.

internalArticles.get.title: Get Internal Article
internalArticles.get.description: Retrieve an internal article via GET /internal_articles/{id}.

internalArticles.update.title: Update Internal Article
internalArticles.update.description: Update an internal article via PUT /internal_articles/{id}.

internalArticles.delete.title: Delete Internal Article
internalArticles.delete.description: Delete an internal article via DELETE /internal_articles/{id}.

dataAttributes.create.title: Create Data Attribute
dataAttributes.create.description: Create a contact or company data attribute via POST /data_attributes.

dataAttributes.update.title: Update Data Attribute
dataAttributes.update.description: Update a data attribute via PUT /data_attributes/{id}. The data type cannot be changed.

dataEvents.create.title: Create Data Event
dataEvents.create.description: Submit a data event via POST /events. Identify the contact with email, userId, or id.

dataEvents.list.title: List Data Events
dataEvents.list.description: List data events for a contact via GET /events. Pass email, userId, or id (maps to intercom_user_id).

summary.description: Return summaries instead of event list.

dataEvents.summaries.title: Create Data Event Summaries
dataEvents.summaries.description: Create event summaries for a user via POST /events/summaries.

dataExport.create.title: Create Data Export
dataExport.create.description: Create a message-content data export job via POST /export/content/data.

dataExport.get.title: Get Data Export
dataExport.get.description: Get a content data export job via GET /export/content/data/{jobIdentifier}.

dataExport.cancel.title: Cancel Data Export
dataExport.cancel.description: Cancel a content data export job via POST /export/cancel/{jobIdentifier}.

dataExport.download.title: Download Data Export
dataExport.download.description: Download a completed content data export via GET /download/content/data/{jobIdentifier}. Live responses are gzip; this operation still issues that GET.

contentImportSources.list.title: List Content Import Sources
contentImportSources.list.description: List AI content import sources via GET /ai/content_import_sources.

contentImportSources.create.title: Create Content Import Source
contentImportSources.create.description: Create an AI content import source via POST /ai/content_import_sources.

contentImportSources.get.title: Get Content Import Source
contentImportSources.get.description: Retrieve an AI content import source via GET /ai/content_import_sources/{id}.

contentImportSources.update.title: Update Content Import Source
contentImportSources.update.description: Update an AI content import source via PUT /ai/content_import_sources/{id}.

contentImportSources.delete.title: Delete Content Import Source
contentImportSources.delete.description: Delete an AI content import source via DELETE /ai/content_import_sources/{id}. Imported pages are also deleted.

externalPages.list.title: List External Pages
externalPages.list.description: List AI external pages via GET /ai/external_pages.

externalPages.create.title: Create External Page
externalPages.create.description: Create or update an AI external page via POST /ai/external_pages.

sourceId.description: Content import source id (maps to source_id).

aiAgentAvailability.description: Available to Fin Agent (maps to ai_agent_availability).

aiCopilotAvailability.description: Available to Fin Copilot (maps to ai_copilot_availability).

externalPages.get.title: Get External Page
externalPages.get.description: Retrieve an AI external page via GET /ai/external_pages/{id}.

externalPages.update.title: Update External Page
externalPages.update.description: Update an AI external page via PUT /ai/external_pages/{id}.

sourceId.description: Content import source id (maps to source_id).

externalPages.delete.title: Delete External Page
externalPages.delete.description: Delete an AI external page via DELETE /ai/external_pages/{id}.

counts.get.title: Get Counts
counts.get.description: Retrieve Intercom counts via GET /counts. Optional type selects conversation, user, company, lead, tag, segment, or contact counts.

jobs.get.title: Get Job Status
jobs.get.description: Retrieve asynchronous job status via GET /jobs/status/{id}.

updatedSince.description: Only macros updated since this timestamp (maps to updated_since).

macros.get.title: Get Macro
macros.get.description: Retrieve a saved-reply macro via GET /macros/{id}.

awayStatusReasons.list.title: List Away Status Reasons
awayStatusReasons.list.description: List Inbox away status reasons via GET /away_status_reasons.

calls.transcript.title: Get Call Transcript
calls.transcript.description: Retrieve a call transcript via GET /calls/{id}/transcript.

calls.search.title: List Calls with Transcripts
calls.search.description: Retrieve calls for conversation ids via POST /calls/search, including transcripts when available. Maximum 20 conversation ids.

conversationIds.description: Conversation ids (maps to conversation_ids). Maximum 20 per Intercom.

finVoice.register.title: Register Fin Voice Call
finVoice.register.description: Register an external Fin Voice call via POST /fin_voice/register.

customObjectInstances.getByExternalId.title: Get Custom Object Instance by External ID
customObjectInstances.getByExternalId.description: Fetch a custom object instance via GET /custom_object_instances/{customObjectTypeIdentifier}?external_id=.

conversations.snooze.title: Snooze Conversation
conversations.snooze.description: Snooze a conversation via POST /conversations/{id}/parts with message_type snoozed. snoozedUntil is a UNIX timestamp.

adminId.description: Admin performing the snooze (maps to admin_id).

snoozedUntil.description: UNIX timestamp when the conversation should reopen (maps to snoozed_until).

conversations.update.title: Update Conversation
conversations.update.description: Update a conversation via PUT /conversations/{id}. Sets read, title, and custom_attributes; optional display_as=plaintext query.

displayAs.description: Set to plaintext to return message bodies as plain text (maps to display_as).

conversations.convert.title: Convert Conversation to Ticket
conversations.convert.description: Convert a conversation into a ticket via POST /conversations/{id}/convert.

conversations.redact.title: Redact Conversation Part
conversations.redact.description: Redact a conversation part or source via POST /conversations/redact.

sourceId.description: Source message id when type is conversation_source (maps to source_id).

messages.create.title: Create Message
messages.create.description: Create an admin-initiated in-app or email message via POST /messages.

createConversationWithoutContactReply.description: Open an inbox conversation without waiting for a reply (maps to create_conversation_without_contact_reply).

newsItems.create.title: Create News Item
newsItems.create.description: Create a News Center item via POST /news/news_items.

newsItems.get.title: Get News Item
newsItems.get.description: Retrieve a news item via GET /news/news_items/{id}.

newsItems.update.title: Update News Item
newsItems.update.description: Update a news item via PUT /news/news_items/{id}.

newsItems.delete.title: Delete News Item
newsItems.delete.description: Delete a news item via DELETE /news/news_items/{id}.

newsfeeds.listItems.title: List Live Newsfeed Items
newsfeeds.listItems.description: List live items for a newsfeed via GET /news/newsfeeds/{id}/items.

visitors.update.title: Update Visitor
visitors.update.description: Update a visitor via PUT /visitors. Identify the visitor with id or userId.

visitors.convert.title: Convert Visitor
visitors.convert.description: Convert a visitor into a user via POST /visitors/convert.

customObjectInstances.create.title: Create or Update Custom Object Instance
customObjectInstances.create.description: Create or update a custom object instance via POST /custom_object_instances/{customObjectTypeIdentifier}.

externalCreatedAt.description: External created_at UNIX timestamp (maps to external_created_at).

externalUpdatedAt.description: External updated_at UNIX timestamp (maps to external_updated_at).

customObjectInstances.deleteByExternalId.title: Delete Custom Object Instance by External ID
customObjectInstances.deleteByExternalId.description: Delete a custom object instance via DELETE /custom_object_instances/{customObjectTypeIdentifier}?external_id=.

customObjectInstances.get.title: Get Custom Object Instance by ID
customObjectInstances.get.description: Retrieve a custom object instance via GET /custom_object_instances/{customObjectTypeIdentifier}/{id}.

customObjectInstances.delete.title: Delete Custom Object Instance by ID
customObjectInstances.delete.description: Delete a custom object instance via DELETE /custom_object_instances/{customObjectTypeIdentifier}/{id}.

phoneCallRedirects.create.title: Create Phone Switch
phoneCallRedirects.create.description: Send a Messenger SMS deflection via POST /phone_call_redirects.

customAttributes.description: Custom attributes to store on the contact (maps to custom_attributes).

contacts.listTickets.title: List Contact Tickets
contacts.listTickets.description: List tickets attached to a contact via GET /contacts/{id}/tickets.

sections.get.title: Get Help Center Section
sections.get.description: Retrieve a help center section via GET /help_center/sections/{id}.

sections.update.title: Update Help Center Section
sections.update.description: Update a help center section via PUT /help_center/sections/{id}.

sections.delete.title: Delete Help Center Section
sections.delete.description: Delete a help center section via DELETE /help_center/sections/{id}.
